impact: Key-man and governance risk on the AI bellwether a week before its Nov 17 earnings; money rotated to AMD. Watch for read-through to MU, NBIS and the memory complex if the probe widens.
summary: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman US intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy, and into reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. Trump said the FBI is looking into it. Shares closed down about 4.2% at $178.81, erasing roughly $192B, while the market rallied.
title: Nvidia falls 4.2% as board probes Jensen Huang's ties to alleged Chinese spy
